leadStory: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time at MetLife to win the 2026 World Cup, making Victor Munoz a world champion twenty-two days into a Liverpool career in which he has not yet trained or played.
subject: Victor Munoz lifted on team-mates' shoulders in a Spain shirt under stadium floodlights, confetti falling, the trophy celebration behind him
